changelog:
lygo-mint-verifier v1.1.1 — Security-audit fixes, stricter consent enforcement

- `backfill_anchors.py` no longer auto-appends `--i-consent`; user must provide it explicitly.
- All compatibility wrappers strictly honor the consent gate; never inject consent flags.
- `self_check.py` now verifies enforcement of consent (“consent_wrapper_honest” and “backfill_requires_consent”).
- Security audit link added to SKILL.md; improved accuracy of declared permissions.
- Removed obsolete documentation file (`skill-card.md`).
summary: LYGO-MINT Verifier — canonicalize a pack, deterministic SHA-256, append-only + canonical ledgers, portable Anchor Snippet for posting anywhere (Moltbook/X/Discord/4claw). Pure local stdlib: no subprocess, no network, no auto-publish. Ledger writes need --i-consent. Pairs with lygo-mint-walkthrough, lygo-continuum-integrator, lygo-geodesic-sealer. Use for Champion/alignment prompt packs and verifiable receipts.
